rationale: C10 plausibly supplied a concrete, material drafting template for the child. The two orders follow nearly the same full operative sequence: establish a presidential commission with a presidentially designated chairman and members; authorize and direct a detailed, lettered inquiry; require a written report with legislative or administrative recommendations; authorize public hearings and witnesses; direct executive-agency cooperation and information sharing; finance the commission from an Emergency Fund allotment using the same statutory exceptions; and terminate the commission thirty days after its report. C20 and C03 contain substantial portions of the same commission machinery, but C10 is markedly closer in language, ordering, and overall structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established a commission to be known as the President's Commission on the Health Needs of the Nation, which shall consist of a chairman and fourteen other members to be designated by the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby created a Commission to be known as the President's Commission on Migratory Labor, which shall consist of a Chairman and four other members to be designated by the President.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical commission-creation formula, adapted only in name and membership size.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Commission is authorized and directed to inquire into and study the following:
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission is authorized and directed to inquire into
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared introduction to a detailed, lettered catalogue of study subjects.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Commission shall present to the President in writing such interim reports and final report ... including its recommendations for governmental action, either legislative or administrative
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission shall make a report of its studies to the President in writing ... including its recommendations for Governmental action, either legislative or administrative.
shared_material.explanation: Close verbal correspondence in the reporting and recommendation provision.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In connection with its inquiries and studies, the Commission is authorized to hold such public hearings and to hear such witnesses as it may deem appropriate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In connection with its studies and inquiries, the Commission is authorized to hold such publ8ic hearings and to hear such witnesses as it deems appropriate.
shared_material.explanation: Essentially identical hearing authority, with only minor word-order and editorial differences.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require in the performance of its functions and duties
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require in the performance of its duties.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation entitled "Emergency Fund for the President, National Defense" ... Such payments shall be made without regard to the provisions of (a) section 3681 ... (b) section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909 ... and (c) such other laws as the President may hereafter specify.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation appearing under the heading "Emergency Fund for the President" ... Such payments shall be made without regard to the provisions of section 3681 ... section 9 of the Act of March 4, 1909 ... and such other provisions of law as the President may hereafter specify.
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the same funding mechanism and unusually specific statutory exceptions, updated for the later appropriation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Commission shall cease to exist thirty days after rendition of its final report to the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Thirty days after rendition of its report to the President, the Commission shall cease to exist
shared_material.explanation: The same report-triggered termination mechanism in closely corresponding language.
